name: Kie.ai
short: Multi-modal AI API aggregator specializing in video, image, music, and text generation. Provides unified API access to 200+ models (including Kling, Seedance, Veo, Flux, Suno, and frontier LLMs) via a credit-based pay-as-you-go system with welcome test credits.

plans.name: Free trial
plans.notes: One-time welcome grant of ~80 test credits (~$0.40 value) upon registration to test endpoints.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Prepaid credit packs; billed per image, per second of video/audio, or per 1M tokens. Failed generation tasks are never charged.
